Name: Customizable Death Penalty
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Customizable Death Penalty[/size]
[size=3]
This mod lets you choose what the penalty is for dying. You can (individually) choose to:

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Disable item loss[/size]
[*][size=3]Disable money loss[/size]
[*][size=3]Remember mine levels[/size]
[*][size=3]Restore your stamina[/size]
[*][size=3]Restore your health[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[u]By default, the mod only disables item loss.

[/u]To enable the other options:
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Run the game once (to generate a config.json file).[/size]
[*][size=3]Close the game after the title screen has shown up.[/size]
[*][size=3]Modify the config.json file (inside the CustomizableDeathPenalty folder) how you want! To enable an option, change the corresponding false to true (or vice versa).[/size]
[/list][size=3]If you already have a config.json file created, just skip to step 3.

Note that [u]you'll still see the dialog box[/u] saying you lost things, but [u]you won't actually lose them[/u]. Sorry, I couldn't remove it.

Requires [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url] by Pathoschild.

Place the CustomizableDeathPenalty folder inside of your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install.[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url]
